hook_text: Before you draw a single step, write the rules you will judge yourself by. Numbers, limits, values.
clip_script: The brief: one paragraph. Design stairs and a ramp with rails, for everyone, from the paving to the hall door, 600 up, in a space 12 by 4, in concrete and steel, within budget. Facts of the site, not the answer. Then specifications, the must-be list, every one testable: 1 in 12 or gentler, 1 200 wide, equal risers 150 to 180, treads 250, rails at 900 both sides, landings of 1 200, kerb of 75, non-slip. Then constraints, the limits you did not pick: space, money, shops, time, law. Then considerations, the values: safety, cost, looks, people, planet. Now sketch. Later, you will hold every idea against this yardstick, and so will the tender board.
visual_style: Whiteboard page with four boxes labelled Brief, Specifications, Constraints, Considerations filling one line at a time; a ruler icon beside the specifications.
pacing: Brief in one breath, specs as a fast list, constraints, considerations, the yardstick payoff.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write a three-line brief for a better school bag.
